title: Sporadic incidents of violence mark polling in 23 ULBs and 3,240 Gram Panchayats in Andhra Pradesh
description: Polling percentage in ULBs is tentatively put at 62.50, while the Gram Panchayats registered a percentage of 74.67; tension gripped Ahobilam in Nandyal district when the YSRCP supporters resorted to stone-pelting resulting in damage to a few vehicles and injuries to several persons
